div.head: Northu 54.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif se landrica nelle to steore filstan, þonne habbe Crist ⁊ cyningc þa bote.
And gif se landrica nelle to steore filstan, þonne habbe Crist and cyningc þa bote.
Und wenn der Immunitätsherr zur Bestrafung zu helfen sich weigert, dann erhalte Christus [Bischof] und König das Bussgeld.
And if the lord with jurisdiction will not help with the punishment, then let Christ [the bishop] and the king have the fine.
And if the lord of the estate will not help in the punishment, then Christ and the king are to have the compensation.
And if the local lord will not aid in the enforcement, then Christ and the king are to receive the compensation.

note.seg: Der halbe Strafgeldempfang devolviert an die Krone nur, wo der Immunitätsherr die Polizei zu üben unterlässt; s. Gl Gerichtsbarkeit 6. Regelmässig also ist dieser der Gerichtsherr eines landagend; vgl. o. 49¹

The receipt of half the fine devolves on the Crown only where the lord of the immunity fails to exercise the police power; see Gl Gerichtsbarkeit 6. As a rule, therefore, the latter is the judicial lord of a landagend; cf. above 49¹
